learning_objective: 🎯 Get ready to become a math detective by finding hidden rules in numbers and shapes so you can easily predict what comes next!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A number sequence is like a secret code where numbers line up based on a hidden rule. Once you figure out if the numbers are jumping up by adding or shrinking down by subtracting, you can guess the next number in the blink of an eye!
Patterns are not just for numbers; they live in everyday shapes and dot grids too! By watching how triangles, squares, or dots grow and change step-by-step, we can draw the next shape perfectly.
Every single pattern has a 'magic rule' that connects one term to the next. Finding this special rule is super important because it is your very first step into the amazing world of algebra!

fun_activity.title: 🧩 The Matchstick Train Challenge
fun_activity.instructions: Grab some matchsticks or colorful pencils and build a growing train of squares. Count how many sticks you need for 1 square, then 2 squares, and see if you can write down the secret rule for your pattern!

quick_recap: ⭐ Patterns are everywhere in math, showing us how numbers and shapes change in a steady and predictable way.
⭐ Every sequence has a hidden rule, like 'add 3' or 'multiply by 2', waiting for you to discover it.
⭐ Once you know the magic rule, you can find the 10th or even the 100th term without writing them all out!
